name: Buddy Agent — Voice-Controlled Laptop Operator
description: Voice-activated assistant for opening/closing apps, folders, and browser control. Wake word: 'Hey Buddy'. Strict permission boundary. 8-second session window after wake word.
author: Swaraj Shelke

commands.open_app: Open an application (e.g., 'Open Chrome', 'Start VS Code')
commands.browser_search: Search the web (e.g., 'Search for Python tutorials', 'Google the weather')
commands.browser_tab: Manage tabs (e.g., 'Open a new tab and search YouTube', 'Close this tab')
commands.file_open: Open safe user folders (e.g., 'Open my downloads', 'Show desktop')
commands.file_search: Search for files by name (e.g., 'Search for resume', 'Find a file called budget')
